def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Social simulation runner")
    parser.add_argument("--file", help="Path to JSON input file")
    parser.add_argument("--url", help="URL to JSON input")
    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=None, help="Random seed for reproducibility")
    parser.add_argument("--timeout", type=float, default=10.0, help="Network timeout in seconds")
    parser.add_argument("--retries", type=int, default=3, help="Network retries for URL inputs")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    if bool(args.file) == bool(args.url):
        eprint("Provide exactly one of --file or --url")
        sys.exit(1)

    try:
        if args.file:
            text = load_text_from_file(args.file)
        else:
            text = load_text_from_url(args.url, timeout=args.timeout, retries=args.retries)
    except Exception as e:
        eprint(f"Failed to load input: {e}")
        sys.exit(1)

    data = parse_json(text)
    validate_input(data)
    result = run_simulation(data, seed=args.seed)
    print(json.dumps(result))
    sys.exit(0)
